taxonomy_summary: Diapus aculeatus Blandford, 1894. Original description and historical taxonomic treatments are displayed with claim-specific source verification; provisional distribution and host assertions remain separate from nomenclatural decisions.
nomenclature_note: The species was originally described as Diapus aculeatus, the same genus used here. No additional accepted taxonomic synonym has been established in this audit.
